customerMessage: Performance Level helps you choose a simple device behavior preset. Results depend on your phone, Android version, ROM, root status, and enabled modules. Use Balanced for normal daily use.

levels.title: Off
levels.summary: Do not apply any performance preset.

levels.title: Battery Saver
levels.summary: Show safer battery guidance and supported Android settings shortcuts.

levels.title: Balanced
levels.summary: Recommended daily profile for normal smoothness and safer defaults.

levels.title: Smooth
levels.summary: Show display and refresh-rate guidance where supported.

levels.title: Performance
levels.summary: Gaming or heavy-use profile. Must show heat and battery-drain warnings.
levels.risk: Higher battery drain and heat possible

levels.title: Custom
levels.summary: Advanced user-controlled settings with reset to Balanced.
